work.note: Existing survey chapter label '1922 · Ulysses' supplies the work's publication year; bibliography identifies the work. This dates publication, not its fictional setting or the lecture's creation.

description: Follows Stephen, Bloom, and Molly through a Dublin day, examining epic correspondences, changing literary forms, kinship, and urban life. Covers Ulysses: Dublin, Empire, Religion, and the Question of Belonging; Who can say what Ireland is?; What the city's official journey leaves outside; A hundred years after the first edition.
